_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/zones/test_tucks_itself_shuffle.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_tucks_itself_shuffle` is the `tucks_itself: "shuffle"` rider on a sorcery that also gains 2 life, so the test can see both that the effects ran and where the card went.

cards.name: Test Tucks Itself Shuffle
cards.oracle_text: You gain 2 life. Shuffle Test Tucks Itself Shuffle into its owner's library.
